newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia dollar drops, debt futures spike on data.
newsitem.headline: Australia dollar drops, debt futures spike on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar tumbled and debt futures rose sharply after the Australian Bureau of Statistics reported that employment dropped by 40,300 in May, pushing the unemployment rate to 8.8 percent.
Forecasts had centred on a 15,000 employment rise with the unemployment rate staying at 8.7 percent.

The dollar was quoted at US$0.7520/30 compared with US$0.7563/68 just before the data release, while June 10-year bond futures were 92.900 against a pre-data 92.775. September bill futures also rose, moving to 94.79 from 94.67.
